main_argument_chains.claim: A government that is also the only firm can fund a wage floor and equal parental leave, cutting the Gini coefficient from 0.58 to 0.36, but a sudden doubling of population breaks the budget.
support_steps: Fit an inverse wage curve to a real sample and scale it
Price the welfare bill and solve for a capped progressive tax
Score the curriculum and price human capital accumulation
Set the childcare cost so that retention equalizes
Show the budget identity fails when only labor scales
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Adopt the floor, the cap and the childcare cost, and refuse to promise the same welfare under an evacuation.

The printed proportionality lines attach the wrong quantity to population and to output. The prose is unambiguous that spending scales with headcount and revenue with output.
The decision matrix prints its discipline rows detached from the score columns. The short-run and long-run totals are legible and the winners match the prose.
